Final application
deadlines.note: Late applications may be accepted but review is not guaranteed.

english.note: Scores must be within two years at the beginning of the enrollment term. Listed US-degree/native-English-country exemptions and discretionary documented waiver requests exist; approval is not guaranteed.

applicationFee.note: No application fee; no waiver needed.

documents: Official transcripts from every undergraduate and graduate institution
WES or ECE official course-by-course foreign undergraduate transcript evaluation
requirements.note: Relevant undergraduate major and minimum GPA 3.0 in the last 60 credits. Research experience and a research-mentor recommendation are strongly encouraged. Students undertake research rotations before selecting a laboratory.

funding.note: All students in good standing receive an undated $37,080 annual stipend, tuition/fees and health insurance. No teaching assistantship is required. Confirm the future stipend in the offer.

timeline.decisions: Decision/acceptance response by April 15, 2027; program start July 26, 2027. Interview dates on the admissions page conflict with the current cycle and are omitted.
